body:
I spoke with @vvo about how instantsearch.js determines whether to use the front-end build or the back-end build. It's using browserify's [package.json `browser` field spec](https://github.com/defunctzombie/package-browser-field-spec) as you can [see here](https://github.com/algolia/algoliasearch-client-js/blob/7d4b7b15ab664bcf9fa45399fbc22304499a1f8f/index.js).

At a bit of a wall now. Current understanding is that Meteor is seeing the require on the server, not in the browser. Will try to look more into whether/how that can be overridden.
